description: Environment variables for GCS configuration. Real values only in local .env (gitignored) or secret manager / deploy config. Placeholders in .env.example.

requiredWhenUsingGcs.name: GCS_PROJECT_ID
requiredWhenUsingGcs.description: GCP project ID that owns the bucket

requiredWhenUsingGcs.name: GCS_BUCKET
requiredWhenUsingGcs.description: GCS bucket name for application object/file storage

requiredWhenUsingGcs.name: GCS_FOLDER
requiredWhenUsingGcs.default: {app_id} — the application id (git remote repo name), matching the {appname}/ folder the deployment platform provisions
requiredWhenUsingGcs.description: Default folder (object-key prefix) inside the bucket where the app stores files. All uploads go under this folder by default (e.g. gs://GCS_BUCKET/GCS_FOLDER/...). Default it to the application id so the app's object keys agree with the platform-provisioned layout.

optionalWifDocs.name: GCS_GSA_EMAIL
optionalWifDocs.description: Document the GSA used with WIF (not a credential; for ops clarity)

optionalWifDocs.name: GCS_KSA_NAME
optionalWifDocs.description: Kubernetes ServiceAccount name annotated for WIF

localAuthOnly.name: GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
localAuthOnly.description: Local/dev only path for ADC key or ADC file. Leave unset on GKE so workload identity supplies credentials. Never commit the file.

rules: Always update .env.example when adding GCS_PROJECT_ID, GCS_BUCKET, or GCS_FOLDER
Use a single GCS_BUCKET — do not invent GCS_BUCKET_UPLOADS / PUBLIC / TEMP unless the user explicitly needs multiple buckets
GCS_FOLDER is the default folder inside the bucket; store files under it (apps may append further sub-paths within that folder)
Default GCS_FOLDER to the application id — the deployment platform provisions the bucket with an {appname}/ folder, and a different prefix silently writes outside it
Auth via Application Default Credentials (GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or workload identity); Storage client is a lazy singleton on globalThis
Do not put service account private keys in env vars; do not set GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS on GKE when using WIF
